Http400.description: The request could not be read.

Http401.description: Sign in with a current Django session.

Http404.description: The record is unavailable or outside the current user’s access.

Http405.description: The HTTP method is unavailable on this route.

Http409.description: A version, state or idempotency conflict requires current readback.

Http413.description: The request exceeds the application size limit.

Http415.description: The request uses the wrong content type.

Http422.description: A field, workflow prerequisite or required configuration needs attention.

Http503.description: A dependency or bounded read is unavailable. Check current state before retrying.
